_comment: Pinned CPython builds for the LAST-RESORT bootstrap path in bin/ensure_python.*.
This is only reached when no usable Python already exists on the machine AND the user
has explicitly consented to a download. A system Python is always preferred; the audit
runs fine with no Python at all.
Builds are python-build-standalone (the relocatable CPython distribution uv uses).
'install_only' archives contain a complete stdlib and need no compilation or installer.
Every archive is verified against the SHA-256 below BEFORE anything is extracted or
executed. The checksums were taken from the release's signed SHA256SUMS manifest.
An archive that does not match is deleted and the bootstrap fails closed - it is never
extracted 'anyway'. A pinned version plus a verified hash is what separates this from
piping a download into a shell, which this skill's own CFG-CI-02 rule flags as a finding.
To upgrade: pick a newer python-build-standalone release, copy its SHA256SUMS entries
here verbatim, and bump 'version' and 'release'. Do not hand-edit a hash.
sizeNoteMB: 25-40 MB compressed per platform; extracted into the user cache, never into the skill folder.
